$comment: The committed reviewer-lens policy surface (SPEC §1.7; issue #169, Directive #166). Committed so a routing decision is diffable and auditable after the fact; caller-owned so nothing a delegate says at dispatch time can select a lens. Rows are matched against the change's own changed-path set by path prefix. A row's prefixes are non-empty by contract — an empty prefix would match every string, including a delegate-shaped claim that is not a path at all. The CONTENT below is deliberately a minimal working set, not a curated taxonomy: §1.7 puts the surface's content outside its own contract, and issue #169 scopes only the surface.
